effect: A counter-offer with nothing to offer can no longer calm a region. To a referendum petition, counter gives the next undevolved power; with none left it gave nothing, yet grievance and organization fell, the petition closed and no new one could come for a year, so fully devolved regions could be stalled for free, and it is the AI's usual answer. Real governments that refuse a vote pay for it, as a refusal here does. km now rejects counter on a referendum petition when no power is left, with the game's existing reason and text (nothing_to_promise). The AI skips a rejected choice (znC) and picks accept or refuse. Expected effect: in fully devolved regions (Quebec, Greenland, Faroe, New Caledonia, the Basque Country and others) grievance rises over the years, or referendums come sooner; size not measured. Day 0 unchanged. No new state. (Minified names in this text are those of build 26403824; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
